init.description: Set up Sheriff in this workspace from an architecture preset (config + deps + eslint + verify script)

domain.description: Generate a vertical-slice domain (app-internal or as nx lib)

feat.description: Generate a feat sub-slice (private, with feat-port) inside a domain

shared-feature.description: Generate a root-level shared feature (port contract + store + providers)

hexagon.description: Generate a hexagon slice (domain/ports/adapters) for the hexagonal presets

migrate.description: Migrate the workspace from the blueprint preset to inverted

doctor.description: Check that Sheriff is correctly wired (config, deps, eslint, script)
